name: services-desk
title: Services desk
purpose: Let staff work a defect report with the platform services: keep its photos in the App's files, rate it with the platform's model, email it to themselves, watch the App's scheduled jobs, and close it through a function only stewards may call.
access: Everyone signed in reads the reports and uses the services the App's layers leave on; only the steward role closes a report, checked in the function, and only its status.
